{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Lost Opportunity''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Vordell]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Among it's crew were the individuals [[Kollu]] and [[Trom]], and along with Vordell, they were captured by the [[Imperial Customs Corvette|Imperial Customs corvette]] [[Auditor (corvette)|''Auditor'']]. The ''Auditor'' traveled to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Phinel's Folly]], where it planned to recover a missing shipment of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], and the ''Lost Opportunity'' was placed on the moon's surface, while it's crew remained in custody aboard the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>
